en_title: German Cost-of-Living Protests Escalate into Violent Riots Across Major Cities
hi_title: क्रिकेट श्रेणी के लिए अनुपयुक्त स्रोत: जर्मनी में प्रदर्शन
en_body:
## Overview

Late on Saturday, violent riots erupted in central Frankfurt as protesters clashed with police, marking a sharp escalation from largely peaceful demonstrations earlier in the day. The unrest also spread to Berlin, Hamburg, and Cologne, prompting authorities to deploy special police units and water cannons.

## Key Locations and Incidents

*   **Frankfurt:** A large section of the main shopping street was closed off by police overnight. Windows of several shops were smashed, and molotov cocktails were thrown at emergency services. Authorities seized two weapons after arresting a suspect, and people broke into other shops to steal items like trainers.
*   **Berlin:** A smaller evening demonstration resulted in 27 police officers being injured and up to 56 people temporarily detained.
*   **Cologne:** Police were attacked near the main train station with bottles thrown and a bicycle launched.
*   **Hamburg:** Individuals dressed in black set off fireworks and set barricades on fire, resulting in 120 arrests.

## Official Responses and Demands

Germany's Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told Bild newspaper that overnight police had prevented "violence like that seen in Paris" and called for "harsh punishments" for rioters and looters. Roman Poseck, interior minister of Hesse state, claimed that "around 100 clearly identified left-wing extremists" had infiltrated the Frankfurt protest, calling the end of the demonstration "shameful."

Organizers behind the demonstrations, the campaign group Gen Z regelt ("Gen Z takes charge"), stated the peaceful protests were aimed at fighting for peace and freedom rather than war and coercion. Spokesperson Lina Friedrich emphasized their focus on better support for health and education systems, opposition to compulsory military service, and a fairer distribution of the burden.

## Context: European Youth Protests

The German unrest occurred on the same day as massive demonstrations across Europe. In France, more than 320,000 people demonstrated over three consecutive weekends, demanding action on the high cost of living and poor public services. While largely peaceful, clashes resulted in over 500 arrests and an attempted murder probe in France following an officer's injury from a molotov cocktail.

In Italy, some clashes between police and demonstrators occurred in Rome and Turin. In Portugal, police moved to clear a new tent camp assembled after thousands marched to protest against a rental bill that they argue could worsen a housing crisis, where house prices have more than doubled over the past decade.

Mostly young protesters across European nations—including Belgium, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece, Serbia, and Albania—have focused their protests on cost-of-living issues such as access to housing, the quality of education, and cuts to public services.

## How to Verify

This report is based on the original BBC News article published approximately 45 minutes prior. Readers can verify the details, including police statements and organizer claims, by visiting the source URL: [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqj34gnd3n30o](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqj34gnd3n30o).

Note: While organizers estimated tens of thousands of protesters, authorities reported significantly lower numbers in Frankfurt, Munich, and Berlin.

## जानकारी

प्रदान किया गया स्रोत पाठ जर्मनी में हुए विरोध प्रदर्शनों, झड़पों और दुकानों में लूटपाट की घटनाओं से संबंधित है, जिसका क्रिकेट खेल, टीमों, प्रतियोगिताओं या मैचों से कोई संबंध नहीं है। 

* **स्रोत विषय:** जर्मनी के फ्रैंकफर्ट, बर्लिन, कोलोन और हैम्बर्ग में जीवन-यापन के खर्च और अन्य मुद्दों को लेकर हुए विरोध प्रदर्शन और हिंसा।
* **लागू निर्देश:** चूंकि उपयोगकर्ता ने श्रेणी 'क्रिकेट' निर्दिष्ट की है और प्रदान किया गया स्रोत पाठ पूरी तरह से एक अलग सामाजिक-राजनीतिक घटना से संबंधित है, इसलिए संपादकीय आवश्यकताओं के अनुसार क्रिकेट मैच, स्कोर या टीमों का विवरण उपलब्ध नहीं कराया जा सकता है।

## सत्यापन

मूल घोषणा और वास्तविक स्थिति की पुष्टि के लिए संबंधित आधिकारिक समाचार आउटलेट्स और स्थानीय पुलिस की प्रेस विज्ञप्तियों की जाँच की जा सकती है।
